## How I tested it

- [ ] `cd frontend && npm run lint && npm run build` shows no errors
- [ ] `cd backend && npm run db:test` passes
- [ ] The matching Postman request(s) pass
- [ ] I opened the changed pages as **admin** and as **customer**
- [ ] Light and dark mode look right

## Checklist

- [ ] No `.env`, real names, phone numbers, emails or passwords in the change (the privacy check passes)
- [ ] New pictures or documents were looked at and marked with `--mark-checked`
- [ ] No tables or columns were added, removed or renamed (or the team agreed)
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/03_api_reference.md`, user guide, database README) where needed
